_contract: The Publication Check (DoktorShift/my_editor#33): what an article needs before it is published, the same in STANDUP's editor (src/utils/publicationCheck.js) and in MyEditor (nostr/readiness.py, which vendors this file). Served as GET /api/publication-check/rules. Discover takes its thresholds from limits.discover (backend/core/discover_selection.py). tests/fixtures/publication_check_cases.json pins the verdicts for both apps. Sentences use {name} placeholders only, never | plurals or @: three formatters read them. Severities per outcome: nostr is Ready to Publish, standup is Ready for STANDUP; a code missing from an outcome is not checked there. Findings are listed in this order, most pressing first.

size._about: STANDUP's crawler drops events over max_bytes, measured as compact JSON with every non-ASCII character escaped (relay_pool.py _event_byte_size). The check measures the unsigned event { kind, created_at, tags, content } that way and adds allowance_bytes for id, pubkey, sig and the relay message around it.

discover._about: What lets an article lead and rank on Discover (backend/core/discover_selection.py lead_eligible, suitability, topic_key). Lengths count characters; words are the Markdown text split on white space.

werbelinks._about: A Werbelink is a Markdown link whose title is one of titles (docs/publishing-experience.md). It is disclosed when the article's last paragraph is in italics only and contains one of disclosure_words (backend/htmlgen/md.py _DISCLOSURE_WORDS_RE).

en.body.empty: The article has no text yet.
en.cover.unsafe: The cover’s address can’t be published. Use a web address that starts with https://.
en.size.standup: The article is too long for STANDUP. Shorten it or split it into parts.
en.summary.missing: No summary yet. A sentence or two helps readers decide to read on.
en.cover.missing: No cover picture. Articles with one stand out in lists.
en.tags.missing: No hashtags. They help readers find the article.
en.media.alt_missing.one: 1 picture has no description for people who can’t see it.
en.media.alt_missing.other: {count} pictures have no description for people who can’t see them.
en.date.future: The publication date lies in the future. Readers see the time of publishing instead.
en.sponsored.undisclosed: The article has Werbelinks but no line saying so. Add one in italics at the end.
en.discover.title_short: A real title of at least {count} characters helps the article lead on Discover.
en.discover.summary_short: A summary of at least {count} characters helps the article on Discover.
en.discover.body_short: Discover shows articles of at least {count} words more often.
en.discover.no_topic: None of the hashtags works as a topic on Discover. Add one like bitcoin or lightning.
en.group.title: Title
